title: Power Supply Guide
meta: Everything you need to know about power supplies.
body:
Power supplies are one of the most overlooked parts of any PC build. Many people spend hours choosing a graphics card and a processor, then grab whatever power supply is cheapest. That can lead to crashes, coil whine or worse.

At Example PC we get a lot of questions about power supplies, especially from customers buying our Aurora 12GB graphics card. So we put together this guide.

First, a bit of background. A power supply converts AC power from the wall into the DC power your components use. Efficiency ratings like 80 PLUS Bronze, Gold and Platinum tell you how much power is wasted as heat. Higher is better, but Gold is the sweet spot for most builds.

So what do you need for the Aurora? We recommend a 650 W power supply for a typical build with a mid-range processor. If you run a high-end processor or plan to overclock, step up to 750 W for more headroom. Make sure the unit has two PCIe 8-pin connectors, because the Aurora draws up to 250 W on its own.

We hope this guide helps. Check out our power supply range for great deals.

title: How to Dial In Espresso at Home: A Step-by-Step Guide
meta: Learn how to dial in espresso at home with a simple recipe: 18 g in, 36 g out, in 25 to 30 seconds. Adjust grind first, then dose.
body:
To dial in espresso, start with a fixed recipe of 18 g of coffee in and 36 g of espresso out, aim for a shot time of 25 to 30 seconds, and change only the grind size until you hit that time. Then adjust by taste.

Why start with a ratio? A 1:2 ratio is a reliable middle ground for most medium roasts. It gives you a stable target so you are not changing three things at once.

Step 1: Weigh your dose. Use a scale accurate to 0.1 g and put 18 g of freshly ground coffee in the basket.

Step 2: Pull the shot and time it. Start the timer when you start the pump and stop it when the scale reads 36 g.

Step 3: Adjust the grind. If the shot ran faster than 25 seconds, grind finer. If it ran slower than 30 seconds, grind coarser. Move one step at a time.

Step 4: Taste. Sour and thin means under-extracted, so grind finer or pull a longer ratio. Bitter and dry means over-extracted, so grind coarser.

Beans roasted within the last 7 to 21 days are easiest to dial in. Very fresh beans release a lot of gas and can make shots inconsistent.

We asked our founder, a licensed esthetician with 12 years of experience, to share her secrets. Grab a cup of tea and settle in, because this is going to change your life.

The golden rule is to apply products from thinnest to thickest. In the morning, that means cleanser, then a vitamin C serum, then moisturizer, then sunscreen. At night, swap the vitamin C for a retinoid and skip the sunscreen.

title: Bike Sizing Explained | Corsa Cycles Blog
meta: Not sure what size bike you need? Our guide explains frame sizes, inseam measurements and how to get the right fit.
body:
Getting the right size bike is the single most important thing you can do for comfort. A bike that is too big or too small can cause back pain, sore wrists and knee problems.

Bike sizes are measured in different ways depending on the brand. Road bikes are often sized in centimeters, mountain bikes in inches, and many brands now use S, M and L. That is why it helps to know your own measurements rather than relying on a size label.

The two numbers that matter most are your height and your inseam. To measure your inseam, stand against a wall in socks, put a book between your legs and measure from the top of the book to the floor.

As a rough guide for our bikes, riders from 160 to 170 cm usually fit a size S, 170 to 180 cm a size M, and 180 to 190 cm a size L. If you are between sizes, choose the smaller frame for a more upright, nimble ride.

When you stand over the bike you should have about 2 to 5 cm of clearance above the top tube. Still unsure? Book a free 30-minute fit session at any Corsa Cycles store.

title: Puppy Feeding Schedule: How Often to Feed a Puppy by Age
meta: Feed puppies 4 meals a day until 12 weeks, 3 meals until 6 months, then 2 meals a day. See our chart and portion tips.
body:
Most puppies need 4 meals a day until 12 weeks old, 3 meals a day from 3 to 6 months, and 2 meals a day from 6 months onward. Large and giant breeds may stay on puppy food longer, but the meal schedule is the same.

Why so many meals? Puppies have small stomachs and high energy needs. Splitting food into several meals keeps blood sugar steady and makes house training more predictable.

How much to feed depends on the food and your puppy's expected adult weight, so start with the chart on the bag and adjust. You should be able to feel your puppy's ribs without seeing them.

Switch to adult food at around 12 months for most breeds, or 18 to 24 months for giant breeds. Make the change gradually over 7 days by mixing in more of the new food each day.

If your puppy skips more than two meals in a row, or has vomiting or diarrhea, call your vet.

title: Cast Iron Care 101 - Hearthstone Cookware
meta: Tips and tricks for your cast iron.
body:
There is nothing quite like cooking in cast iron. Our grandmothers swore by it, and once you get the hang of it you will too. Here at Hearthstone we have been pouring cast iron in our Ohio foundry since 1952, so we know a thing or two about keeping it in great shape.

A lot of people are scared of cast iron because they have heard it rusts or that you can never use soap. The truth is that cast iron is tough, and a well-seasoned pan will last for generations.

So how do you season it? Start with a clean, dry pan. Rub a very thin layer of a high smoke point oil, such as flaxseed, canola or vegetable shortening, over every surface, then wipe off as much as you can with a paper towel. Place the pan upside down in the oven at 450°F for 1 hour, then let it cool in the oven. Repeat 3 to 4 times for a durable base layer.

After that, everyday cooking keeps the seasoning going. A little mild soap is fine. Just dry the pan on the stove and add a few drops of oil after each wash.

Every Hearthstone skillet arrives pre-seasoned and is covered by a lifetime warranty.
notes: The actual seasoning steps sit in the third paragraph behind nostalgia, and the title, meta and .html URL never use the question people search.
